$comment: Registry of the enumerations. The only source of the values of CHECK … IN (…) in DDL 09–16, edge/e0* and MAIL_KINDS (shared/src/enums.gen.ts, pnpm contracts:gen).

values — sections keyed by the names in stages: base — the core values, then one section per DDL section. A section is extended together with the memory_check_extend block of the same DDL section, in the same commit. Values are never removed.
The registry holds only the values the DDL allows: the schema test inserts a row for every value and compares the constraint in the database with the registry (equality).

uses — where the enumeration stands in the database: database, table, column, constraint name, the DDL section that creates the column (stage), and a probe for the schema test — inserting one row, {v} is replaced by the value in quotes. If the table does not exist yet, the probe is skipped.
x-probe-setup — preparation of the probes in each database (once, before the inserts).
Each section in values is its own line after an empty one: edits of neighboring sections merge without conflicts (the contract validator checks it).
settings.category locale is added by 17-basic-tails.sql, which is applied after the main schema files, so it is listed in the last section, 5.
